answer: Each identity holds a credential renewed by its issuing authority every epoch: a fresh $12 fee and 20 minutes of verification per alias, like shale layers that only form one at a time. The kernel of the defence is that renewal cannot be batched - 464 aliases need 464 separate renewals, about $5,568 and 154 hours per epoch. If over 5% of a cluster renewals fail or share one issuing officer, the cluster freezes and its 500-POA bond is slashed 100%. A 150-agent farm was caught by a whisper-quiet audit when 132 renewals carried the same officer signature.
